name: app-6a78a80578348191b5d3594846cb9913
description: Write, schedule and publish social media posts from ChatGPT with Posty: Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord and Slack. Plan a content calendar, preview every post per account, and manage scheduled posts in the Posty app inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Write, schedule and publish social media posts without leaving ChatGPT. Posty connects to your Facebook pages, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord and Slack accounts, so you can go from an idea to a scheduled post in one conversation.

What you can do:
- Ask ChatGPT to write a post, a thread or a week of posts, adapted to each platform and its character limit.
- See a preview card per account with the name, the handle, the local publish time and the character count before anything is saved.
- Schedule for a date and time, save as a draft, or publish now, on one channel or many at once.
- Add images and videos from the conversation, from a link, or from your own device.
- Ask what is going out this week, and cancel a scheduled post.
- Open the Posty app from the ChatGPT sidebar or beside a conversation: a content calendar, a composer and your channel list. Select a post and ask ChatGPT to rewrite it.
- In the ChatGPT desktop app, type @ to point at a channel or an upcoming post.

Posty is a social media scheduler made in Hungary for small businesses, creators and agencies. Your timezone and the workspace ChatGPT works in are in the plugin settings.

Limitations: social accounts are connected in Posty itself, not in ChatGPT. A published post cannot be removed from the platform by Posty. Analytics are not available in ChatGPT. You need a Posty account whose workspace includes API access.
defaultPrompt: Write an Instagram and Facebook post about our weekend offer and schedule it for Friday 9:00.
Plan next week's LinkedIn posts for my business and show me the previews.

positive.description: Import a valid public image into the Posty media library for later attachment.
positive.prompt: Import this image into my Posty media library: https://www.w3.org/People/mimasa/test/imgformat/img/w3c_home.jpg
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the stored Posty media identifier and its hosted media URL, or a concise validation error if the file cannot be imported.

positive.description: List the connected channels, then preview an image post on Facebook and Instagram before any write occurs.
positive.prompt: Which social channels are connected to my Posty workspace? Preview a draft post with that imported image on the Facebook Page and on the Instagram channel, saying: Submission review test, please do not publish. Show me each account's exact name and handle.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected channels with their names and handles. The preview card shows the Facebook and Instagram accounts with the prepared text, its character count, each channel's own character limit, the attached image, and the publication time in the user's timezone. No post is created.

positive.description: Create the confirmed drafts on Facebook and Instagram, publishing nothing.
positive.prompt: I confirm the preview. Create it as drafts on both channels, scheduled one week from now, and do not publish anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one Posty draft per channel with the image attached and returns each post ID with the account name and handle. Nothing is published to either platform.

positive.description: Refuse a photo on YouTube: video-only validation with a clear message.
positive.prompt: Now try to schedule that same photo post on the YouTube channel too.
positive.expected_behavior: Posty refuses: the validation reports that the attached item must be a video, because YouTube accepts only video uploads. No YouTube post is created, and the reply explains what is missing.

positive.description: Open the Posty app on the calendar, then delete the two drafts, leaving the workspace as it was.
positive.prompt: Open my Posty calendar so I can see those two drafts, then delete both of them.
positive.expected_behavior: The Posty app opens with the calendar and shows both drafts with their channel names, handles and local times. Then both drafts are deleted, the reply names the channel for each, and a following list_posts call confirms they are gone.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for connecting a new social account. Authorization happens in Posty's own connection screen.
negative.prompt: Connect my Instagram account to Posty for me.

negative.description: Do not trigger for social analytics, which the Posty tools do not expose.
negative.prompt: Show me my Instagram engagement analytics for last month.

review.commerce_description: Posty does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Plans are chosen and paid on posty.hu.

publication.release_notes: Posty is now an app inside ChatGPT: open it from the sidebar or beside a conversation for a content calendar, a composer and the channel list. Plugin settings for timezone and workspace. Channels and upcoming posts in the @ menu of the desktop composer. A getting started guide after installation.

hu-HU.subtitle: Közösségimédia-ütemező
hu-HU.description:
Írj, ütemezz és tegyél közzé közösségimédia-bejegyzéseket a ChatGPT elhagyása nélkül. A Posty összeköti a Facebook-oldalaidat, az Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord és Slack fiókjaidat, így egy beszélgetésben jutsz el az ötlettől az ütemezett posztig.

Mire használhatod:
- Kérd meg a ChatGPT-t, hogy írjon egy posztot, egy threadet vagy egy egész heti tartalmat, platformonként a saját karakterkorlátjához igazítva.
- Minden fiókhoz előnézeti kártyát kapsz a névvel, a felhasználónévvel, a helyi időponttal és a karakterszámmal, mielőtt bármi elmentődne.
- Ütemezz dátumra és időpontra, ments piszkozatként, vagy tedd közzé azonnal, egy vagy több csatornán egyszerre.
- Képet és videót adhatsz hozzá a beszélgetésből, linkről vagy a saját eszközödről.
- Kérdezd meg, mi megy ki a héten, és törölj egy ütemezett posztot.
- Nyisd meg a Posty alkalmazást a ChatGPT oldalsávjából vagy egy beszélgetés mellett: tartalomnaptár, bejegyzésíró és a csatornáid. Jelölj ki egy posztot, és kérd meg a ChatGPT-t, hogy írja át.
- A ChatGPT asztali alkalmazásában a @ jellel egy csatornára vagy egy következő posztra mutathatsz.

A Posty magyar közösségimédia-ütemező kisvállalkozásoknak, tartalomgyártóknak és ügynökségeknek. Az időzónád és a munkaterület, amelyben a ChatGPT dolgozik, a bővítmény beállításaiban van.

Korlátok: a közösségimédia-fiókokat magában a Postyban csatlakoztatod, nem a ChatGPT-ben. Megjelent posztot a Posty nem tud eltávolítani a platformról. Elemzések nem érhetők el a ChatGPT-ben. API-hozzáférést tartalmazó Posty munkaterület szükséges.
